mapper.select: SELECT stock.drug_id, drug.drug_code, drug.drug_name, drug.drug_format, drug.drug_unit, stock.quantity, stock.version, stock.updated_at FROM drug_stock stock LEFT JOIN drug_info drug ON drug.id = stock.drug_id WHERE stock.drug_id = #{drugId}
mapper.sql: stock.drug_id, drug.drug_code, drug.drug_name, drug.drug_format, drug.drug_unit, stock.quantity, stock.version, stock.updated_at

where.if: AND ( stock.drug_id = #{keywordId} OR drug.drug_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR drug.drug_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR drug.mnemonic_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM drug_stock stock LEFT JOIN drug_info drug ON drug.id = stock.drug_id
ORDER BY stock.quantity ASC, stock.drug_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drug_stock stock LEFT JOIN drug_info drug ON drug.id = stock.drug_id
mapper.sql: tx.id, tx.drug_id, drug.drug_code, drug.drug_name, tx.prescription_id, tx.transaction_type, tx.quantity, tx.quantity_before, tx.quantity_after, tx.operator_user_id, tx.created_at
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM drug_stock_transaction tx LEFT JOIN drug_info drug ON drug.id = tx.drug_id
ORDER BY tx.created_at DESC, tx.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drug_stock (drug_id, quantity, version) VALUES (#{drugId}, #{quantity}, 0)
